 Follow ‘Yellowjackets’ Sneak Peek: Final Season Teases Savage Homecoming In First-Look Photos
 Glenn Garner Thu, November 5, 2026 at 10:51 PM UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. (Darko Sikman/Paramount+) 
 Although the Yellowjackets have made it home in Season 4, they’re not quite out of the woods yet.
 On Thursday, Paramount released the trailer and first-look photos from the fourth and final season of the survival thriller created by Ashley Lyle and Bart Nickerson, which sees the team return home to New Jersey after finally being rescued from 19 months stranded in the Canadian wilderness.
 Premiering Nov. 20 on Paramount+ with Premium Plan, season 4 of Yellowjackets features returning stars Melanie Lynskey, Christina Ricci, Tawny Cypress, Sophie Nélisse, Jasmin Savoy Brown, Sophie Thatcher, Samantha Hanratty, Courtney Eaton, Liv Hewson, Warren Kole, Kevin Alves, Sarah Desjardins, Nia Sondaya, Jenna Burgess and Hilary Swank.
 Guest starring in the final season are June Squibb, Elijah Wood, Molly Ringwald, Devon Sawa, Sam Braun, Dulé Hill and more.
 See images from Season 4 of Yellowjackets below.
